text:
Julia (customer): hey, we're seeing a bunch of errors from the embeddings endpoint since ~09:00 UTC. bulk job failing with "DimensionMismatchError" and lots of 503s. payloads haven't changed on our side. any idea?
Sam (support): sorry to hear that — can you paste the request body (just sizes/types) + the exact error text? also which region are you hitting?
Julia (customer): here's stripped repro: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer SK_..." \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-1024","input":["doc1","doc2"],"batch_size":64}'
error: {"error":"DimensionMismatchError","message":"expected embedding dim=1536 but got dim=1024"}
Sam (support): aha — error says expected 1536 but client sent 1024. model param says redwood-embed-1024 though? can you confirm the model name in code/runtime?
Julia (customer): we do set redwood-embed-1024 everywhere. why would the service expect 1536?
Maria (sre): pinging infra — my hunch: routing to a different model variant in eu-west that uses 1536 (we have two active variants for rollout). also seeing higher cold starts in eu-west-1a around the time reported. adding logs.
deploy-bot: autoscaler: detected spillover in region eu-west-1 at 2026-07-12T08:58:21Z — routing some requests to fallback pool (model-variants: redwood-embed-1536)
Aj (eng): dump of routing decision log for Julia's API key (redacted):
```
2026-07-12T08:58:19Z req_id=abc123 key=acct_987 region=eu-west-1 prefer_region=eu-west-1 route=eu-west-primary -> variant=redwood-embed-1536 pool=shared-fallback
```
```
error seen: "expected dim=1536 got dim=1024"
Aj (eng): looks like when primary pool saturated we fall back to compatible architecture but we didn't enforce model-identity check for embeddings dims. bug. for text gen we have fallbacks, but embeddings must guarantee dims or return 409/upgrade warning.
Sam (support): timeline: Julia's client requested redwood-embed-1024 -> routed to eu-west primary which is saturated -> fallback to shared pool running redwood-embed-1536 -> server returns DimensionMismatchError. We should have rejected fallback earlier.
Priya (prod): this explains complaints about increased latency + billing anomalies for some customers — fallback to a larger-dim model will change token cost & output shape. we need an action: immediate mitigation + medium-term fix.
Maria (sre): mitigation options: 1) pin routing by region/header (x-redwood-region: eu-west-1) or customer config to avoid fallback pool; 2) change fallback policy to return 409 when model variant dims differ; 3) hot-warm prewarm for common embed models to avoid cold-start spillover.
Sam (support): Julia — for immediate unblocking can you add header: 
  -H "x-redwood-preferred-region: us-east-1"
or set model to redwood-embed-1536 if you can accept that dims change. Also reduce batch_size to 8-16 temporarily to avoid triggering batching spikes.
Julia (customer): ok will try preferred-region header now. also what's the recommended batch size? we've been sending 64s to optimize throughput.
Aj (eng): recommended: start with batch_size <= 16 for embeddings in multi-tenant shared pools. Dedicated customers can safely use 64-128. batching=64 on a cold/shared pool amplifies cold-start/memory pressure -> spillover.
Sam (support): pls paste results after you try header. we'll monitor logs for your API key.
Julia (customer): response after header: 200 OK, embeddings come back length=1024. latency 120ms vs 1.8s earlier. thanks! :relieved:
Sam (support): great. I'll keep this thread open while infra/eng push a fix.
Aj (eng): immediate engineering task: add sanity-check on fallback to verify embedding dim equality before routing; if mismatch then return 409 + message that variant incompatible. Estimated 2-3hr hotfix plus deploy. PR in progress.
Priya (prod): communicate to customers: small advisory (in console & status page) that embedding dims must match and that temporary routing fallbacks may change dims. we should also flag accounts that hit fallbacks.
Maria (sre): ops task: adjust autoscaler to pre-warm redwood-embed-1024 instances in eu-west at p95 traffic levels to avoid spillover during peaks. Also enable per-region capacity thresholds to stop cross-region spillover when unsafe.
Sam (support): action items summary -> 1) Aj to land fallback-dim-check hotfix (2-3h) 2) Maria to tune autoscaler & pre-warm (4-24h) 3) Priya to draft CS/console advisory (today) 4) Support to reach out to customers who hit fallbacks (Sam) 5) Short-term customer workaround: set x-redwood-preferred-region or reduce batch_size.
Aj (eng): attaching debug lines we added to PR for logs (paste):
```
if fallback_variant.dim != requested_variant.dim:
  log.warn("fallback-dim-mismatch", req_id=req_id, want=requested_variant.dim, got=fallback_variant.dim)
  return error(409, "Embedding variant incompatible: expected dim=%d got=%d" % (requested_variant.dim, fallback_variant.dim))
```
Maria (sre): note — we also saw billing delta for Julia's account because embedding price for 1536 variant is higher; billing team will reconcile credits for customers affected.
Priya (prod): I'll coordinate the message and post on status.redwood.ai once we have hotfix merged.
Sam (support): Julia, we'll follow up once the fix is deployed. anything else you need now?
Julia (customer): all good for now. appreciate the fast help. please ping when fixed so we can remove the preferred-region header.
Sam (support): will do. closing when hotfix is live. :white_check_mark:
